name: Dragonhide Belt, +3

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Regain Focus
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): regain 1d8 Focus Points.

summary: +3 to the save DC of your Monk features; once a day, regain 1d8 Focus Points.
text: Stitched finely from dragonhide, this belt adds +3 to the saving throw DC of any Monk feature you have that spends Focus Points. Once per dawn, you can also take a Magic action to roll 1d8 and regain that many expended Focus Points.
